description: 125B-total / 6B-active MoE model. Needs --n-cpu-moe tuning since expert weights get streamed from RAM over PCIe - the PCIe 3.0 card matters most here.
gpu_devices_note: Physical Vulkan indices from llama-bench --list-devices on THIS machine: 0 = UHD 770 iGPU (excluded), 1 and 2 = the A770s.

autotune.note: n_cpu_moe_candidates are swept high-to-low (more offloaded -> less offloaded). autotune.py stops at the first VRAM-OOM and backs off one step, per the upstream-recommended sweep method.

tuned.note: Filled in automatically by autotune.py - do not hand-edit unless you know what you're changing.
